description: This file defines the 'Result' class within the AWS SDK for PHP, representing the result of an AWS API call. It includes methods for checking key existence, retrieving data, searching with JMESPath expressions, and converting the result to a JSON string.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: Represents an AWS API result, providing methods for data access, search, and string representation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Result object with optional data array.

methods.name: hasKey
methods.description: Checks if a specific key exists in the result data.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a specific key.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a JMESPath search on the result data.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a pretty-printed JSON string representing the result data.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Deprecated method; performs a search with slashes replaced by dots.
